blocking.title: A landing whose transports are destroyed tells the player 'not done: no transports of its nation with room for it are at a port it can reach' and nothing says they were sunk; for a US landing whose group was bombed in Norfolk the reason is false (an idle group stood at San Francisco; the same click an hour later makes a landing there). Those left for the next voyage of a sunk landing get the same refusal
blocking.fix: In landings.ts (gather's 'no group left' and the sailing branch with no fleets): a landing whose last group is destroyed calls another (callTransports, as R37a's busy call) and is over only if none comes; when over, it is told by its own reason or news kind ('its transports were sunk at port / at sea'), naming the division, not RejectReason.NoTransports; the same for those waiting for a next voyage. AT: c47_far.ts USA 3517 (Chicago to Norwich) has no reason-6 refusal at t273; a unit case of a gathering landing whose group is destroyed at port while another group is idle gives no reason 6; c47_sunk n3k2: the one at the port is told its transports were sunk.
